en.quote: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
en.riddle: Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said
en.speaker: God

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־יוֹנָה הַהֵיטֵב חָרָֽה־לְךָ עַל־הַקִּֽיקָיוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר הֵיטֵב חָֽרָה־לִי עַד־מָֽוֶת
he.speaker: אֱלֹהִים
